name: 喵喵
description: 官方确认的国际服草系御三家（叶猫），性格亲和，战斗中每回合回复能量、续航出色。未被选中的御三家可在好友的世界中捕捉。国际服完整技能与进化链待 CBT 官方图鉴公布。
descriptionEn: Officially confirmed Grass-type global starter (a leaf cat) with a friendly demeanor; recovers energy each turn for strong sustain. Unpicked starters can be caught in friends' worlds. Full skills and evolution line TBA via the official CBT codex.

name: 火花
evolution: 火花 → … → Pyreon（可 Alpha 化 Blazion）
description: 官方确认的国际服火系御三家（火牛），高爆发输出，前期开荒与推剧情效率最高。最终进化为 Pyreon，可通过 Alpha 血统临时变身为 boss 级形态 Blazion。中间进化形态待 CBT 官方图鉴确认。
descriptionEn: Officially confirmed Fire-type global starter (a fire ox) with high burst damage and the fastest early-game pacing. Its final evolution is Pyreon, which can temporarily Alpha-transform into the boss-level Blazion. The intermediate stage TBA via the official CBT codex.

name: 水蓝蓝
description: 官方确认的国际服水系御三家（水泡），坦度优秀，水泡盾 + 水炮循环生存能力出色。英文名取自 cerulean（蔚蓝）加可爱后缀 -la。完整技能与进化链待 CBT 官方图鉴公布。
descriptionEn: Officially confirmed Water-type global starter (a water blob) with excellent bulk and a bubble-shield / water-cannon survival loop. Its English name derives from 'cerulean' with a cute '-la' suffix. Full skills and evolution line TBA via the official CBT codex.

name: 焰犬
description: 官方预告与媒体试玩中出现的火系野外精灵（狼），领地意识强，会对闯入领地的玩家咆哮。注意：焰犬并非御三家。详细信息待 CBT 官方图鉴确认。
descriptionEn: A Fire-type wild Jinie (wolf) shown in official previews and press hands-ons. Highly territorial — it growls at players who enter its territory. Note: Blazehound is NOT a starter. Full details TBA via the official CBT codex.

name: 水爪
description: 官方预告与媒体试玩中出现的野外水系精灵（龟），性格胆小，受惊时会缩进壳里防御。注意：水爪并非御三家。详细信息待 CBT 官方图鉴确认。
descriptionEn: A wild Water-type Jinie (turtle) shown in official previews and press hands-ons. Timid by nature — it hides inside its shell when startled. Note: Catapawn is NOT a starter. Full details TBA via the official CBT codex.

name: 尘帚
description: 官方确认的普通系扫帚精灵，性格友善，会主动帮忙清理玩家帽子上的灰尘。详细信息待 CBT 官方图鉴确认。
descriptionEn: An officially confirmed Normal-type broom Jinie with a friendly demeanor — it kindly cleans the dust off your avatar's hat when given the chance. Full details TBA via the official CBT codex.
